Apply to CEE's Graduate Program
UC Davis Civil and Environmental Engineering offers M.S. and Ph.D. degrees. Known for our state-of-the-art research facilities, productive laboratories and progressive spirit, CEE offers collaborative and interdisciplinary curricula through graduate research and designated emphasis options, bringing students and faculty together to address real-world challenges.
UC Davis CEE master’s and doctoral graduates become leaders in their fields and go on to guide, define and impact change within our global community.
All applicants must indicate an area of specialization on the application, and are admitted directly into that research area.
